items.title: Wellman Braud Interview, 1958-03-31
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] This is the young dog. Mr. Brooke was on this, then. ... [INTERVIEWER] And you're on this one, then, too, Mr. Brooke. [INTERVIEWEE] Yes, I'm on that.

ctx.x: They have what they call six-eighth time. They have what they call to play some in two full time. See what I mean? Well, who would use those? Well, brass bands, like a minister band, they use six-eighth time for the street. You understand? And some tunes, they used two full times. And some tunes, yeah, two full times, like Sally Trombone, that was a great street number, because there was plenty of trombone in there. You remember that? There had plenty of trombone in there. Yeah. They have two trombones in the…
This is the young dog. Mr. Brooke was on this, then. Let's start it again. Yeah, go ahead. The very beginning.
And you're on this one, then, too, Mr. Brooke.
